***Ally recognized by Money, Fortune, PEOPLE, Forbes, American Banker and Newsweek for customer value, workplace culture, leadership and trust***


DETROIT


, Nov. 2, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Ally Financial (NYSE: ALLY) today announced it has earned national recognition across banking, workplace culture, leadership and trust from six leading organizations, including Money's Best National Bank and Best Online Bank, Fortune's Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance (No. 12), Forbes' Dream Employers, three top 10 rankings in American Banker's 2026 Most Powerful Women in Banking™ program, and Newsweek's World's Most Trustworthy Companies (No. 44). The awards recognize Ally's focus on delivering value to customers, building a culture where employees thrive, developing recognized leaders, and earning the trust of the communities it serves.


## **Why Ally Bank Ranks Among the Best National and Online Banks**


Ally Bank earned top marks across three Money Best Banks 2027 categories, recognized for its combination of competitive rates, minimal fees and strong customer service across its all-digital banking platform.


- [Money: Best National Bank — Best Overall (2027)](https://money.com/best-national-banks/#ally)


Money evaluated over 115 retail banks, credit unions and regional institutions on asset size, account fees, deposit minimums, ATM accessibility, and customer satisfaction ratings. Ally was named Best Overall for its combination of competitive rates, no monthly maintenance fees, and strong JD Power customer satisfaction scores.


- [Money: Best Online Bank — Best Overall (2027)](https://money.com/best-online-banks/)


Money evaluated all-digital banks on account options, APYs, fee structure, customer satisfaction, ATM access and online tools. Ally was named Best Overall for its high APYs across all deposit accounts, no monthly maintenance fees, and extensive fee-free ATM network.


- [Money: Best Banks for Savings Accounts — Best Digital Savings Tools (2027)](https://money.com/best-savings-accounts/)


Money evaluated savings accounts on access to funds, account fees, APYs, customer service, financial standing, fraud


protection, FDIC insurance, and mobile app quality. Ally was named Best Digital Savings Tools for its savings buckets, which organize savings into up to 30 categories within one account, and automated boosters — recurring transfers, round-ups, and Surprise Savings, which find safe-to-save funds in linked checking accounts.


## **How Ally Builds a Top Workplace in Financial Services**


Ally's workplace recognitions point to a purpose-driven culture built on doing right by employees and the communities they serve — spanning both internal culture and external community impact.


- [Fortune: Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance (2026), No. 12](https://fortune.com/ranking/best-workplaces-financial-services-insurance/)


Fortune partnered with Great Place to Work to analyze survey feedback representing more than 194,000 U.S. employees in the industry. Ally rose two places from No. 14 in 2025, marking its highest ever ranking.


- [PEOPLE: Companies That Care (2026), No. 79](https://www.greatplacetowork.com/best-workplaces/companies-that-care/2026)


The Companies that Care list highlights the top U.S. companies that have succeeded in business while demonstrating outstanding respect, care and concern for their employees, their communities and the environment. Great Place To Work selected the list based on over 1.3 million confidential survey responses from companies representing more than 7.3 million U.S. employees.


- [Forbes: America's Dream Employers 2027](https://www.forbes.com/companies/ally-financial/?list=americas-dream-employers)


Ally was recognized on the 2027 list. The ranking draws on surveys of more than 10,000 U.S. college students and 142,000 U.S. workers about the employers they consider dream employers, along with factors including growth opportunities, quality of work, company reputation, professional development and working conditions.


## **Who Are Ally's Recognized Leaders in Banking**


Three Ally leaders ranked in the top 10 across their respective American Banker 2026 Most Powerful Women in Banking lists.


- [Lindsay Sacknoff, President of Consumer Banking, Ally Financial — No. 4, Women to Watch (2026)](https://www.americanbanker.com/list/2026-the-most-powerful-women-in-bankings-women-to-watch)


Sacknoff oversees strategy and design for Ally's digital financial solutions and manages bank operations including fraud


and financial crimes


, consumer insights, and the customer care and experience group supporting 3.6 million customers at the nation's largest all-digital bank.


- [Stephanie Richard, Chief Risk Officer, Ally Financial — No. 9, Women to Watch (2026)](https://www.americanbanker.com/news/2026-the-most-powerful-women-in-banking-women-to-watch-9-stephanie-richard-ally-financial)


Richard, a newcomer to the ranking, was recognized for modernizing Ally's approach to risk management, shifting the focus from reporting and process to strategic decision-making, accountability, and business performance.


- [Yasmin Tailor, Executive Director and Consumer Banking CFO, Ally Financial — No. 8, NEXT (2026)](https://www.americanbanker.com/news/2026-the-most-powerful-women-in-banking-next-8-yasmin-tailor-ally-financial)


The NEXT list ranks leaders aged 40 and below based on their growing contributions to their banks. In her role, Tailor was recognized for helping lead a major consumer banking transformation, overseeing retail deposits, brokerage and advisory assets, and consumer-facing operations.


## **Why Ally Is Ranked Among the World's Most Trustworthy Companies**


Trust is at the core of Ally's "Do It Right" philosophy — and the Newsweek recognition shows how customers, investors and employees perceive that commitment.


- [Newsweek: World's Most Trustworthy Companies (2026), No. 44 in Financial Services & Investment](https://rankings.newsweek.com/worlds-most-trustworthy-companies-2026/financial-services-investment)


The World's Most Trustworthy Companies 2026 recognizes 1,000 companies that have earned confidence across customers, investors and employees. The ranking is based on approximately 200,000 company evaluations from more than 65,000 people across 20 countries, complemented by an analysis of over 320,000 media mentions. The overall score consists of 80% survey results (40% customer trust, 40% investor trust, 20% employee trust) and 20% social listening analysis.


For a complete list of Ally's awards and industry recognitions, visit the[Ally Media Center Awards and Recognitions page .](https://media.ally.com/awards-recognition)


**About Ally Financial**
Ally Financial Inc. (NYSE: ALLY) includes the nation's largest all-digital bank and an industry leading auto finance business, driven by a mission to "Do It Right" for its customers and communities. Ally is a U.S. financial holding company with $203 billion in assets and 9.7 million customers (September 30, 2026). Ally Bank, Member FDIC, offers online banking products, including high-yield savings and no hidden fee checking, and was the first major U.S. bank to eliminate overdraft fees. Ally also provides investing solutions through Ally Invest, including online brokerage, automated investing, IRAs and personal financial advice. As a leader in auto finance, Ally provides consumer and dealer financing, insurance, and vehicle remarketing services. Ally's seasoned corporate finance business provides capital to equity sponsors and middle-market companies. Visit[ally.com](https://www.ally.com/) .
